editions.label: Greek — Tischendorf 8 (printed-form digital text)
editions.method: Version 2.8 Unicode kethiv column; source punctuation and reference labels retained. Qere and morphology remain in compressed originals. Printed apparatus is not in this dataset.

editions.label: Greek — Nestle 1904 digital base text
editions.method: Verse text extracted from the dos Santos XHTML component; punctuation retained, markup removed. Historical printing identity is not newly verified by this import.

editions.label: Greek — SBLGNT (official text, v1.2)
editions.method: Official verse text, including its textual marks, preserved. This is an edited comparison text, not an independent manuscript witness.

editions.label: Greek — Westcott–Hort (unaccented digital text)
editions.method: Mechanical ASCII-to-Greek alphabet conversion from the unaccented source; no accents, breathings or lost punctuation reconstructed. Source ASCII retained in compressed originals.

editions.label: Greek — OpenGNT (unaccented Koine module)
editions.method: OGNT_KoineGreek module: original lunate sigma and unaccented text retained, font markup removed. Upstream NA-equivalence claim is not independent verification and does not include the NA apparatus.

editions.label: Greek — Sinaiticus original hand (John 1:1–5 sample)
editions.method: Normalized display derived from identified TEI words; source abbreviations/expansions and corrections are retained in NTGL originals. No image verification. Two views are one physical witness.

editions.label: Greek — Sinaiticus ca-corrected view (John 1:1–5 sample)
editions.method: Normalized display derived from identified TEI words; source abbreviations/expansions and corrections are retained in NTGL originals. No image verification. Two views are one physical witness.

limits: Imported editions are comparison sources, not NTGL adopted readings
Tischendorf printed apparatus is NOT supplied by the 2.8 dataset
Sinaiticus is a five-verse sample only
Matching reference labels do not prove cross-edition verse equivalence
